name: OlaXBT
rootCause: A reported OlaXBT incident on 2025-09-01 affected BNB Chain and was classified in public hack catalogues as a social-engineering attack involving signer phishing. Publicly available evidence remains limited, and no primary disclosure, transaction trace, or technical postmortem was identified during research. The available public record classifies the incident as signer phishing under a social-engineering attack category. No primary incident disclosure, compromised signer details, transaction evidence, or postmortem describing the exact compromise path was identified.
